fato_historico: 2001: War on terror: In the first such act since World War II, US President George W. Bush signs an executive order allowing military tribunals against foreigners suspected of connections to terrorist acts or planned acts on the United States.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to fortify your boundaries, Capricorn. Much like the historical strength once sought to protect global order, you may find it is a good time to establish firm foundations. Consider protecting your emotional energy with the same diligence as a four-leaf clover finding safety in a wild, sprawling field of green.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the quiet wisdom of protecting what you cherish most.
significado_numero: Represents the stability and grounding force of a solid foundation.
conselho: Trust your instincts when setting personal boundaries to invite more luck.
